Catchword-like word "Gravius" at lower right is a signature-like word at the foot, not a catchword in the strict sense; it is placed right below the last line.

main_text.p: Mortuus in monte veteri apud majores inhumatus, de quo Streithagenus.

p.i: At vero in dulces crudelis mente parentes,

main_text.p: Adolpho igitur Gerhardus ex fratre Wilhelmo Ravensburgio Comite nepos, successit: sub Sigismundo & Friderico Austriaco Impp. factus Dux Montium tertius, Juliæ quintus, Geldriæ 7. comesque Ravensburgius: quem Sigismundus Imperator an. 1437. in Vigilia exaltationis crucis Pragæ ad petitionem Ioannis de Stamheim & Nicolai de Gisse legatorum suorum omnibus his Provinciis inauguravit, ejusque in imperio successor Fridericus 3. Austriacus in vigilia S. Petri ad vincula anno 1412. confirmavit.
Uxorem habuit Sophiam Saxonico Leoburgicam, Bernhardi Saxoniæ Angariæ & Westphaliæ Ducis filiam.

Quæ cum aliquandiu sterilis maneret, cum conjugibus Theodoricus Morsanus Archipræsul Colon. datis centum florenorum millibus transfegit, ut sine hæredibus relictis excedentes Ducatus Iulius & Montanus diœcesi Col. accederent, iisdem vero extantibus Dominium Blanckenbergicum obtineret.

Pactis anno 1450. vesperâ Iacobi Apostoli ex parte Archiepiscopi subscripserunt, præter ipsum Archiepiscopum, Decanum, & Capitulum Metropolitanum, Wilhelmus Comes Limburgius Bedburæ Dominus, Gumprechtus Comes Neuwenarius Dominus in Alpenn/ Archipræfectus Coloniensis, Robertus Comes Vierneburgius, Ioannes Reifferscheidæ, Dickæ, & Alsterae Dominus Archimarescalcus, Wilhelmus Wefflinghoviæ, Roerichius Rennenbergæ Dominus, Adamus ab Oetgenbach Dominus in Ehrenstein/ Ioannes Burggravius Reineccensis Dominus in Broich & Tomberg/Lotharius Zuadus ejusdem Tombergæ, ficut etiam Landtzeronæ Dominus, Ioannes à Gimmenich Vischeliæ toparcha, Gerhardus ab Einenberg Landtscronæ quoque toparcha, Scheiffardus à Merode Dominus in Bernheim/ Engelbertus ab Orsbeck Dominus in Oplbrugh/ Gothardus Drachenfelsæ hæres in Oplbrugh quoque Dominus, Theodorus Beisel à Gimmenich/Ioannes ab Venebergh/& Ioannes ab Hangschlede/ equites, Ioannes Drachenfelsæ Dominus, Arnholdus ab Hoemen Dominus in Oedenkirchen / Scheiffardus à Merode Dominus in Hemmersbach Ioannes à Scheidungen/ Ioannes ab Hoemen/ Heidtgenius à Weier Emundus Beissel à Gimmenich/ Henricus Rolman à Velenberg/Adamus ab Hensclaer/ Henricus Rolue à Dettelhoven/Conradus Worde in Rephoven/ Henricus Wolffin Ludinghausen Gothardus & Hermannus Furstenberg/ Henricus ab Ense Gerhardi filius, Conradus Roist Arnholdus & Henricus à Beringhausen/Fridericus Ketlerus, Volbrechtus Scheide/ VVichardus ab Ense dictus Schindelwindt Bernhardus Gravius

page.notes: Black letter names are rendered as bl; several German surnames in the black letter block are uncertain and may contain printing or reading errors, e.g. "Alpenn", "Rephoven", "Furstenberg", "Alsterae". Line-end hyphens have been joined. Gravius at the foot is a closing word of the list rather than a catchword.
